tokens.name: bg-top
tokens.usage: Screen background, top of a vertical gradient to bg-bottom.

tokens.name: bg-bottom
tokens.usage: Screen background, bottom of the gradient; also the fade under the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: card-from
tokens.usage: Blocker tile, start of its 145° gradient (top-left).

tokens.name: card-to
tokens.usage: Blocker tile, end of its 145° gradient (bottom-right).

tokens.name: panel-top
tokens.usage: Frosted row (Blocker rules), top of its gradient. Blur 20px, saturate 160%.

tokens.name: panel-bottom
tokens.usage: Frosted row, bottom of its gradient.

tokens.name: glass-top
tokens.usage: Glass controls (sidebar button, tab bar), top of the gradient. Blur 22px, saturate 180%.

tokens.name: glass-bottom
tokens.usage: Glass controls, bottom of the gradient.

tokens.name: option-base
tokens.usage: Mode card base. The card is this colour mixed with the accent: 6% in Light, 14% in Dark (Dark starts from the ring's centre colour). The selected chip mixes 20% / 40%. Solid, no shadow, no border.

tokens.name: ring-groove-from
tokens.usage: Ring groove (the 300px base), start of its 145° gradient.

tokens.name: ring-groove-to
tokens.usage: Ring groove, end of its gradient.

tokens.name: ring-disc-from
tokens.usage: Ring centre disc (224px), start of its 145° gradient.

tokens.name: ring-disc-to
tokens.usage: Ring centre disc, end of its gradient.

tokens.name: ring-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of the ring, 24px stroke under the arc.

tokens.name: sheet-top
tokens.usage: Confirm sheet, top of its vertical gradient. Blur 30px, saturate 170%.

tokens.name: sheet-bottom
tokens.usage: Confirm sheet, bottom of its gradient.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, numbers and labels on every surface above.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Supporting text: status words, summaries, unselected labels. 4.5:1 or better on every surface above.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Chevrons only (3:1 for icons). Never body text.

tokens.name: hairline
